# Pull Request Checklist

## Public Safety

- [ ] No customer names, contacts, screenshots, tenant IDs, logs, credentials, or internal system identifiers
- [ ] No pricing, discounts, margins, contract terms, or commercial negotiation strategy
- [ ] No vendor NDA, trust portal, partner portal, or restricted compliance attachment content
- [ ] No private repository paths, internal task notes, or reviewer-only comments
- [ ] Compliance content is framed as general information, not legal advice

## Source Traceability

- [ ] Important product, partner, award, certification, and compliance claims have a source or are marked for review
- [ ] Dates and verification status are updated where relevant
